scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('public/hot', { force: true })" && vite build && npm run build:filament
scripts.build:filament: node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('public/css/filament', { recursive: true })" && node node_modules/tailwindcss3/lib/cli.js -i resources/css/filament-utilities.css -o public/css/filament/app-utilities.css --config tailwind.filament.config.js --minify
